answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit before joining a work thread, and let reputation build only through verified completed jobs. Trust forms like a mesa: broad and slow to rise. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate stake for every fake identity, then pay for real work on each one before it can influence anything. Cheap clones stay worthless, while a lotus that opens gradually makes mass forgery unprofitable - the attacker pays linearly per identity while the network gains only marginal trust from each new account.
